mapper.sql: SELECT d.id, d.sheet_id, d.product_id, d.order_num, d.tax_price, d.is_gift, d.tax_rate, d.description, d.order_no, d.return_num FROM tbl_receive_sheet_detail AS d
mapper.select: SELECT t.product_id, t.tax_price FROM ( SELECT d.product_id, d.tax_price, s.order_date, s.code, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY d.product_id ORDER BY s.order_date DESC, s.create_time DESC ) AS rn FROM tbl_receive_sheet_detail AS d INNER JOIN tbl_receive_sheet AS s ON d.sheet_id = s.id WHERE d.is_gift = 0 AND s.order_date <= #{orderDate} ) AS t WHERE t.rn = 1 ORDER BY t.order_date DESC, t.product_id
